problem_disposition.summary: trelmitt/claude-skills' build-vs-borrow is the closest single prior-art candidate to deja-vu's own pipeline design (8-stage DETECT→…→RECORD, working sweep script, 4-verdict model, SPDX license buckets, ADR template) — but no reuse grant was found for it, so its code cannot simply be forked or vendored no matter how good the fit is.

candidate_comparisons.summary: 8-stage pipeline, stdlib-only scout script (GitHub+npm+crates+OpenSSF Scorecard), 4-verdict model, SPDX license buckets, ADR template. docs/design.md §6 records that an earlier hunt verified the script runs clean by hand, no keys required. GitHub's automated license detector (Licensee) reports no LICENSE file in the repository. Licensee only matches a specific, known list of license texts and is explicitly not legal advice (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/licenses/licenses). This corpus entry additionally read the repository's root listing and README directly (2026-09-11): no LICENSE file, and no license/rights/copyright mention anywhere in the README text. No explicit all-rights-reserved notice was found either -- the repository is simply silent on rights.

https://docs.github.com/en/rest/licenses/licenses -- Licensee's matching scope and "not legal advice" caveat, verified 2026-09-11

docs/adr/0011-decision-taxonomy-compositional-packet.md -- rights dimension: unknown is the default for a candidate with no discovered license; prohibited requires the hunt to confirm no grant exists via something explicit (e.g. an all-rights-reserved notice or explicitly restrictive terms) -- silence is not that confirmation

uncertainty.residual: GitHub's Licensee plus a direct read of the root listing and README both confirm no LICENSE file and no rights language, but neither is a legal opinion, and no explicit all-rights-reserved notice was found -- the repository is silent, not explicit. Per ADR-11, that state is rights: unknown, not rights: prohibited (prohibited needs an explicit confirmation of no grant); an earlier draft of this entry used prohibited, which overstated what was actually confirmed.
uncertainty.confidence: moderate -- the absence of any license/rights text is now confirmed by two independent checks (Licensee, direct README read), but classifying it as unknown rather than prohibited (per ADR-11's own rule) means the rights conclusion is deliberately less certain than a confirmed all-rights-reserved notice would support

reversibility: high on the rights question itself (if the author later adds a LICENSE, or an explicit grant/restriction is found on closer reading, that only changes future options; it does not retroactively legitimize what was already reimplemented clean-room) — low on unwinding the clean-room reimplementation once shipped, same as any custom-build
